Lean.getProjFnForField?.code: Lean.getProjFnForField? (env : Environment) (structName fieldName : Name) : Option Name
Lean.getProjFnForField?.fullDefinition: def getProjFnForField? (env : Environment) (structName : Name) (fieldName : Name) : Option Name :=   if let some fieldInfo := getFieldInfo? env structName fieldName then     some fieldInfo.projFn   else     none
